OpenVPN access server.description:
OpenVPN Access Server provides a VPN server with web-based administration and client interfaces.

Based on the official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.
OpenVPN access server.more_info:
Create a dedicated Rockstor Share for persistent configuration. The default administrator username is openvpn. Retrieve the initial administrator password from the container log after the first start, using docker logs openvpn-as | grep 'Auto-generated pass'.

For systems behind a router, forward the desired VPN port, normally UDP 1194, from the router to the Rockstor system. There is normally no need to expose the TCP 943 administrative interface through the router.

1194.description: UDP port for OpenVPN VPN connections.
1194.label: UDP port [e.g. 1194]

443.description: TCP port for OpenVPN TCP connections. Host port 9443 is used by default to avoid a conflict with the Rockstor HTTPS service.
443.label: TCP port [e.g. 9443]

943.description: HTTPS port for the OpenVPN Access Server Admin and Client Web UIs.
943.label: Web UI port [e.g. 943]

/openvpn.description: Choose a dedicated Rockstor Share for persistent OpenVPN Access Server configuration and data.
/openvpn.label: Configuration share [e.g. ovpn-as-conf]

/dev/net/tun.description: TUN network device required by OpenVPN Access Server.
/dev/net/tun.label: TUN device [e.g. /dev/net/tun]
